title: FlowDoc Backend Document Structure Database v0.0.1
summary: PLAN accepted the Backend document-structure database v0.0.1 implementation lane after one same-room revision. Backend commit 619dd32decf68ec7f1c3d1e68b64619beeb702c3 adds repository/service/schema foundations for drafts, sections, components, component versions, document versions, bindings, publications, pure field types, section tree validation, and component version create-or-select behavior.
expectedOutput: Project Control acceptance record for the Backend-owned document-structure database v0.0.1 foundation, including automatic WORK-to-PLAN return, same-room revision, exact Backend commit, changed files, Backend gates, accepted scope, intentionally closed domains, cleanup risk, and remaining unknowns.
riskSummary: HTTP gateway routes remain unknown; external callers are not wired; production database provider and migration runner are not selected; SQLite still keeps JSON read snapshots alongside normalized relationship tables; Core and Editor adoption remain unproven; a residual unregistered Codex worktree directory could not be deleted because Windows path-length cleanup was blocked by policy.
